turns.content:
The issue was caused by the Jinja2 template `templates/flags.py.j2` using a slice `features[:-1]` when iterating over the list of features from `config/features.yaml`. This caused the last item in the list (`gift_cards`) to be excluded from the `ENABLED` set in `app/flags.py`.

I have updated the template to iterate over all features.

Summary of changes:
- Modified `templates/flags.py.j2` to remove the `[:-1]` slice from the feature loop.
- Regenerated `app/flags.py` using `make gen` (via `tools/render.py`), which now correctly includes `gift_cards` in the `ENABLED` set.
- Verified the fix by running the test suite.
